issues.title: [Bug]: Claude Auto + Plan silently approves native plan-mode write requests (V2)

inventory_metadata.title: [Bug]: Claude Auto + Plan silently approves native plan-mode write requests (V2)

issues.reported_environment: V2 Claude Auto + Plan; report uses Sonnet 5.5
issues.assessment: User reproduction and maintainer-account automated source triage. Native writes reportedly approved in plan mode. Automated triage is distinguished from independent human runtime confirmation.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Recompute the effective permission ceiling before every child start, queued send and steer; plan/ask cannot silently widen.

issues.title: [Bug]: Backend crash leaves Claude agents running after their runs are marked cancelled

inventory_metadata.title: [Bug]: Backend crash leaves Claude agents running after their runs are marked cancelled

issues.assessment: User logs show Claude descendants continuing after cancelled state. Maintainer-account automated triage corroborates source. Open process-ledger proposal is not a shipped fix.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Isolated hard-kill/restart proof with process incarnation, workspace lease and truthful orphan/unknown state.

issues.title: [Bug]: Delegated-task notifications cancel queued Claude tool calls and tell the agent the user refused

inventory_metadata.title: [Bug]: Delegated-task notifications cancel queued Claude tool calls and tell the agent the user refused

issues.reported_environment: V2 completion notices using steer priority now
issues.assessment: User SDK/control comparison and automated source triage: an immediate completion notice can cancel queued tool calls. This is distinct from human refusal or an explicit stop.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Deliver passive child results through durable receipts; notification delivery must not implicitly interrupt provider work.

issues.title: [Bug]: V2 keep-alive drops queued/waiting threads while UI still shows working

inventory_metadata.title: [Bug]: V2 keep-alive drops queued/waiting threads while UI still shows working

issues.assessment: Initial visible-composer explanation was corrected in discussion: background desktop premount, not simply an open visible chat stream. Needs-more-information remains relevant.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Exercise actual queued/waiting lifecycle and visibility-independent delivery; no upstream UI port.

issues.title: [Bug]: Orchestrator V2 shows no token usage for subagents

inventory_metadata.title: [Bug]: Orchestrator V2 shows no token usage for subagents

issues.assessment: Report and automated source triage identify absent child usage attribution/projection. Missing evidence does not establish zero usage or complete native-child accounting.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Store provider/account/turn attribution and coverage; show unknown separately from observed zero.

issues.title: [IMPORTANT] Moving from T3 Code Orchestrator V1 to V2

inventory_metadata.title: [IMPORTANT] Moving from T3 Code Orchestrator V1 to V2

issues.assessment: Project advisory states one-time DB copy, fresh provider session and excluded checkpoint/tool/approval/plan history. Later V1/V2 databases diverge; shared settings/files do not make rollback a continuing sync. Mobile reports are excluded infrastructure.
issues.proposed_acceptance: A core replacement needs explicit loss disclosure, separate copied DB, migration fixtures, rollback and preserved workspace ownership.

issues.title: Conversations list appears empty after 0.3.6 → 0.3.7 upgrade, but data is intact in SQLite

inventory_metadata.title: Conversations list appears empty after 0.3.6 → 0.3.7 upgrade, but data is intact in SQLite

issues.assessment: Early hydration diagnosis was superseded: later reporter SQL found four soft-deleted threads and client-origin deletion events while projectors were aligned. Upgrade causality was not reproduced. #324 targets a separate hydration case and is now closed unmerged.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Migration/replay/retention checks must distinguish hidden/deleted rows from stale snapshots; never auto-restore or delete from an empty UI alone.

issues.title: [Bug]: Windows upgrade loops on SQLite backup fsync and blocks Codex recovery

inventory_metadata.title: [Bug]: Windows upgrade loops on SQLite backup fsync and blocks Codex recovery

issues.assessment: User reports fsync/EPERM and inconsistent state across copied DB families. #396 remains an open proposal. Merged #1062 shared-home policy is a different boundary, not proof of process-owned-overlay correctness.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Recoverable backup of the entire SQLite DB/WAL family and fresh-process native Windows migration/resume evidence.

issues.title: Deleted or archived projects leave worktrees and database records behind, causing disk growth and projection-repair lockups

inventory_metadata.title: Deleted or archived projects leave worktrees and database records behind, causing disk growth and projection-repair lockups

issues.assessment: Storage growth and repeated repair/startup cost are reported. #724 repair coalescing and #747 safe managed-worktree cleanup merged, covering parts of the report. Overall acceptance is not proved.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Bound startup/retention work; managed, unreferenced, clean workspace cleanup only after ownership and data checks. Measure locally.

issues.title: [Bug]: Quit with a running turn can leave the thread durably quarantined (interrupt failure reported after command admission stopped)

inventory_metadata.title: [Bug]: Quit with a running turn can leave the thread durably quarantined (interrupt failure reported after command admission stopped)

issues.assessment: User timestamps suggest shutdown closes event admission before cancellation activity can persist, leaving quarantine. Related #985 is an open issue, not a merged fix.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Drain accepted lifecycle events in the correct shutdown order; normal quit must not fabricate a provider failure or poison restart.

issues.title: [Bug]: OpenCode 2.x unsupported — server readiness prefix changed and V1 HTTP API routes removed

inventory_metadata.title: [Bug]: OpenCode 2.x unsupported — server readiness prefix changed and V1 HTTP API routes removed

issues.assessment: User reports ready-prefix/API route incompatibility. No project comment or independent reproduction captured. A named older combination is not proof current Synara universally fails.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Version-pinned OpenCode readiness/route fixtures; catalogue connectivity alone cannot certify a first real turn.

issues.title: [Bug]: Profile undercounts Claude and Antigravity usage in mixed-provider histories

inventory_metadata.title: [Bug]: Profile undercounts Claude and Antigravity usage in mixed-provider histories

issues.reported_environment: 0.8.4 modified local build; historical mixed-provider sessions
issues.assessment: Reporter identifies missing historical processed-token attribution; explicitly not every new Claude turn. Related #1251 is an open issue. Preserve modified-build and history qualifiers.
issues.proposed_acceptance: Provider/turn coverage and units must be explicit; quota, context and processed tokens remain separate evidence.

scope: Six T3 and six Synara selected current issues, with all captured comments. Own source/tracker assessment; no runtime reproduction.
